source.check: BNL 2 Jun 1961 p9 'LONDONDERRY Glendermott - John James Snodgrass (retiring member) ... 386; William John Devine ... 121 ... Claudy - William John Eakin (retiring member), Claudy, 236; David John Moore M'Clean, Claudy, 102'.

note: Triennial election of Londonderry Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Two divisions, Glendermott and Claudy, were contested; the other eleven were filled unopposed at nomination on 16 May 1961 (Londonderry Sentinel, 17 May 1961, p. 1), including Ardmore, a Unionist gain. Printed: 'Majority 265. Electorate 649. Percentage poll 78.4 per cent. Spoiled votes 2.' Snodgrass was the retiring member;
